# CANDIDATE: OPENING_RANGE_VWAP_DIVERGENCE_PULLBACK_LONG

**Filed:** 2026-07-09  
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)  
**Type:** new_trigger  
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

When price opens above the opening-range high but VWAP lies below that open, early buying pressure is a value-area pullback that offers a long entry with mean-reversion expectation. This edge exists because institutional algorithms often defend VWAP as a fair value benchmark, creating temporary dislocations when opening-range breaks occur without VWAP confirmation, which tend to revert intraday as liquidity providers step in.

## Mechanism

Entry rule: If the first 5-minute bar's high > OR_high (first 30 min) AND intraday VWAP < open price of that bar AND EMA8 > EMA21 > EMA55 (bullish ribbon) then enter long at the close of that bar. Exit shape: Initial chart‑stop at OR_low, primary target at 1.5×ATR above entry, runner trail of 10% of ATR after hitting 1×ATR profit. Regime hint: Ideal in low‑volatility sessions (ATR20 < 0.5% of price) with VIX < 18, avoiding the first 30 minutes after major news releases.
